review_scope: Read-only supplementary actual SAFE21/theme/external-role evidence; no repo/runtime mutation by reviewer; old131 review unchanged.

case_recommendations.title: Admin 列表、搜索、分页、角色下拉。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Real Admin lists/searches exact newly created QA user and uses role dropdown; all three roles save/reload.
remaining_dimensions: User pagination and complete list fields/empty/no-results cases are not covered by SAFE21.

case_recommendations.title: 新建用户按钮打开/关闭表单，取消恢复原状态。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Real New User form opens for create and duplicate attempt; cancellation closes the duplicate-error form.
remaining_dimensions: Cancel-before-create zero POST and blank/default reset state need explicit assertions.

case_recommendations.title: 用户名/密码必填，角色 administrator/operator/viewer。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Real username/password creation and administrator/operator/viewer role selection/save/login/role readback.
remaining_dimensions: Blank username/password frontend required and invalid server inputs are separate paths; this suite filled valid values.

case_recommendations.title: 创建成功、重复用户名、错误输入。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Real UI creates unique user and list shows it; duplicate username actual POST returns400; earlier login-helper failure superseded for full role lifecycle.
remaining_dimensions: Other malformed input/client-server error feedback branches not tested by this create/duplicate flow.

case_recommendations.title: 修改角色即时保存，刷新后保持。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Same real QA user moves operator->administrator->viewer via UI; each persisted dropdown label survives reload, new actual login/me returns corresponding role.

case_recommendations.title: 后端 `/api/users/{id}` 密码修改、新旧密码生效范围。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Actual PUT password change200; old password login401 and new password login200; new session is logged out, own user retained Viewer.

case_recommendations.title: 当前无删除用户能力，必须明确记录为产品边界，不伪造删除通过。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Own user explicitly retained as Viewer with privately stored random changed password; no fictional user deletion claimed.
remaining_dimensions: This suite did not independently query absence of Delete user controls/API; use separate current boundary evidence if upgrading.

case_recommendations.title: User Lifecycle → 创建、登录、改角色、新会话权限正确
case_recommendations.covered_description: One actual QA lifecycle now has UI create/duplicate, three UI role changes/reloads and three fresh login/me roles, password reset old/new; separate external Admin downgrade proves existing operator token immediately sees viewer and loses cancel permission400->403.
remaining_dimensions: Actual allowed/denied operations after each fresh role login are not all checked; /me role alone does not replace full new-session authorization assertions.

case_recommendations.title: Admin Role Change → New Login → 新会话权限生效，旧会话行为明确
case_recommendations.covered_description: UI role changes followed by fresh logins produce accurate role; external Admin downgrade updates old operator session server permissions/me immediately.
remaining_dimensions: Complete fresh-role allowed/denied operation probes, and unchanged-page UI behavior/convergence timing for role change, remain. Hard reopening UI cannot prove same-page cache convergence.

case_recommendations.title: 跨页缓存和两会话编辑、旧会话改角色后 API 权限、另一标签退出或替换 Token 后保护页面；记录实际收敛时间。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Same QA role persistence and fresh sessions verified; external Admin changes existing operator session so same token now gets403 while me remains200/viewer; hard reopened header reflects Viewer.
remaining_dimensions: Unchanged-page role-control convergence, two concurrent editors, another-tab logout/token replacement protection and convergence duration remain.

case_recommendations.title: Theme 菜单验证 `light/dark/system`，刷新后保持，`theme-color` 正确。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Actual light/dark/system browser theme selections, system media live change, manual modes ignore opposite media; all three survive reload; dark/light classes and actual theme-color match each resolved theme in nine steps.

case_recommendations.title: Header 语言、主题、Profile、退出及确认框。
case_recommendations.covered_description: Header theme component now independently passes actual modes/media/reload/theme-color; prior accepted logout confirm/cancel exists.
remaining_dimensions: Header language controls/refresh persistence and Profile Settings navigation are not completed by this theme test.

defect_recommendations.covered_description: Real system dark-media update and reload both show dark class plus #020817 theme-color; nine manual/system light/dark/media/persistence observations all match.
External Admin downgrades Operator to Viewer; existing-token API changes and UI hard reload only.
remaining_dimensions: Own QA Administrator must downgrade itself to Viewer with unchanged open page; verify controls converge without reload; root separately assigned this real test.
